description:
What is This Part?
This is a Suzuki OEM Complete 11 Piece Light Set.
This kit gives you every light assembly you need including the Interior Dome Light.
Suzuki OEM
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Brake Assembly (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Front Turn Assembly (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Rear Side Marker Assembly (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Front Side Marker Assembly (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Tag Light Assembly (LH & RH)
Qty 1 – Dome Light Assembly
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
